correctness.rationale: Riemann–Hurwitz and an explicit holomorphic basis give genus four. Direct p-semilinear Cartier extraction leaves a two-cycle with coefficients H_q and H_{2q+1}; the central-trinomial differential equation and unique modular recurrence establish H_{2q+1}=(T²-4)^((q+1)/2)H_q. The resultant smoothness condition is t²≠4. H_q(±2) is nonzero; the ODE and q! nonzero prove squarefreeness. Hence the two stable ranks and a-numbers, superspeciality and exactly q reduced exceptional parameters hold for all p≡5 mod6. The standalone verifier independently checks representative primes, but finite experiments are not the infinite proof.
